reviews.name: Suraya
reviews.ate:
Fatteh 
- warm chickpeas, eggplant, crispy pita & tehina yogurt + almonds, cashews & brown butter

Hummous
- chickpeas seasoned with tehina, lemon & garlic

Rakakat
- crispy fried cheese with garlic chives & a sumac lemon toum

Halabi Kebab
- ground lamb kebabs brushed with muhammara, served with a small hummous, charred onion, tomato & pepper

Sumac Spiced French Fries
reviews.notes:
The outdoor space was phenomenal and hope to sit at the chef's table next time. The table was a little small and had a little trouble fitting all the dishes on one table. We also felt that we were sitting too far from each other. 

The side of charred onion, tomato, and pepper that came with the Halabi Kebab was just okay. It was lacking in flavor + texture and the portion was a little small. Everything else was incredible!

We cannot wait to come back!!

reviews.name: Middle Child Clubhouse
reviews.ate:
7 Layer Chocolate Cake
- coffee, sea salt
reviews.notes: A little salty and I wish it were sweeter 😝

reviews.name: Vinaigrette
reviews.ate:
Roasted Veggie and Provolone Sandwich 
- Roasted bell peppers, onions and squash griddled with basil aioli and provolone, on sourdough bread.

Frozen Vinny Palmer
- Blended hibiscus iced tea, fresh lemonade, real pomegranate grenadine
reviews.notes:
Had this sandwich 4 years ago and still think about it to this day. 

Sat outside by one of the oldest oak trees in the city. 

Need to come here again.

reviews.name: Kalaya
reviews.ate:
Shaw Muang
- five flower-shaped dumplings with ground chicken, cucumber and thai chili

Gui Chai
- crispy garlic chive rice cakes with spicy sweet soy sauce

Pla Muk Thod Kreung 
- fried curry squid with long hots, lime leaf and nam jim waan

Gaeng Gai Khao Mun 
- yellow curry with chicken, served with pickled cucumbers and coconut turmeric rice

Sua Rong Hai
- grilled skirt steak with jaew pla ra, served with sticky rice and crudité

Yum Makhua Yao
- marinated eggplant with mint, galangal, fried shallots and prik nam pla

Moo Tod Nam Pla
- crispy pork belly with fish sauce, served with jaew

Passionfruit Coconut Shaved Ice
reviews.notes:
So so good!

The fried curry squid and skirt steak were my favorite. 

The sticky rice was a bit dry. Lydia has had better. We wished we had knives. The skirt steak slices were a little long to be eating without a knife. The pork belly was also a little dry and too sweet. 

#lovethaifood

reviews.name: Dumpling Home
reviews.ate:
Juicy Pork Bao

Fresh Cucumber with Garlic Sauce

Pork Xiao Long Bao

Pork and Vegetable Potstickers

Dan Dan Noodles
reviews.notes:
I have been here a few times and the food is delicious every single time!

Favorites are the juicy pork bao and the cucumber salad.
